##Environment and Libraries SetUp

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(here)
project_library <- here(".r-library", paste(R.version$major,
                                           strsplit(R.version$minor, "\\.")[[1]][1],
                                           sep = "."))
if (dir.exists(project_library)) .libPaths(c(project_library, .libPaths()))

# Publication inputs and outputs, relative to the project root.
in_dir <- here("Data", "data_for_publication")
out_dir <- file.path(in_dir, "WGCNA_analysis")
library(DESeq2)
library(SummarizedExperiment)

# DESeq2 1.48 caches a DESeqDataSet definition that still requires ExpData.
# The DESeq2 namespace is locked, so the union has to be created in .GlobalEnv
# before vst() or subsetting calls validObject().
if (is.null(methods::getClassDef("ExpData", where = asNamespace("DESeq2")))) {
  methods::setClassUnion(
    "ExpData",
    c("matrix", "SummarizedExperiment")
  )
}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(knitr)
library(WGCNA)
library(emmeans)
cor <- WGCNA::cor
allowWGCNAThreads()
```

##Load DESeq2 object (Shoot model) and Trait

```{r Load DESeq2 object (Shoot model) and Trait}
#Load DESeq2 object (Shoot model)
dds_path <- file.path(in_dir, "DEG_analysis", "dds_shoot.rds")
if (!file.exists(dds_path)) {
  stop("DESeq2 object not found: ", dds_path,
       ". Run Section02_DEGAnalysis.Rmd first.")
}
dds_shoot <- readRDS(dds_path)

#Remove Expression Outliers (based on WGCNA sample dendrogram)
outlier_id <- "MTNC184"
if (outlier_id %in% colnames(dds_shoot)) {
  dds_shoot <- dds_shoot[, colnames(dds_shoot) != outlier_id]
  cat("Removed outlier sample: ", outlier_id, "\n", sep = "")
}
cat("dds: ", nrow(dds_shoot), " genes, ", ncol(dds_shoot), " samples\n")

#Load Trait Data
phys_file <- file.path(in_dir, "Trait_A17_sunn.csv")
phys <- read_csv(phys_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
cat("Physiology: ", nrow(phys), " samples\n")
```

##Data-Preprocessing and Quality Control

```{r Data-Preprocessing}
#Set Output Directory
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output directory: ", out_dir, "\n", sep = "")

#VST transformation of Data and restructuring to match WGCNA format
vsd <- DESeq2::vst(dds_shoot, blind = FALSE)
expr <- assay(vsd)  # genes x samples
datExpr <- t(expr) #sample x genes
rownames(datExpr) <- colnames(expr)
colnames(datExpr) <- rownames(expr)
cat("Expression matrix: ", nrow(datExpr), " samples x ", ncol(datExpr), " genes\n")

#Match Trait Data sample with the Expression Data
samp_ids <- rownames(datExpr)
phys_match <- as.data.frame(phys %>%
  dplyr::filter(RNA.seq.id %in% samp_ids) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(RNA.seq.id, .keep_all = TRUE))
rownames(phys_match) <- phys_match$RNA.seq.id
phys_match <- phys_match[samp_ids, ]
cat("Matched physiology: ", nrow(phys_match), " samples\n", sep = "")
```

```{r Samples QC}
gsg <- goodSamplesGenes(datExpr, verbose = 3)

if (!gsg$allOK) {
  if (sum(!gsg$goodGenes) > 0) {
    cat("Removing ", sum(!gsg$goodGenes), " genes with too many missing values or zero variance\n")
  }
  if (sum(!gsg$goodSamples) > 0) {
    cat("Removing ", sum(!gsg$goodSamples), " outlier samples\n")
  }
  datExpr <- datExpr[gsg$goodSamples, gsg$goodGenes]
}
cat("After filtering: ", nrow(datExpr), " samples x ", ncol(datExpr), " genes\n")

sampleTree <- hclust(dist(datExpr), method = "average")
par(mar = c(0, 4, 2, 0))
plot(sampleTree, main = "Sample clustering to detect outliers",
     xlab = "", sub = "", cex = 0.7)

# Save plot
pdf(file.path(out_dir, "01_sample_dendrogram.pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
par(mar = c(0, 4, 2, 0))
plot(sampleTree, main = "Sample clustering to detect outliers",
     xlab = "", sub = "", cex = 0.7)
dev.off()
```

##Soft Threshold Selection and WGCNA network construction

```{r Identify soft-threshold}
powers <- c(c(1:10), seq(12, 20, 2))
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(datExpr, powerVector = powers, networkType = "signed", verbose = 5)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(sft$fitIndices[, 1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[, 3]) * sft$fitIndices[, 2],
     xlab = "Soft Threshold (power)", ylab = "Scale Free Topology Model Fit, signed R^2",
     type = "n", main = paste("Scale independence"))
text(sft$fitIndices[, 1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[, 3]) * sft$fitIndices[, 2],
     labels = powers, cex = 0.9, col = "red")
abline(h = 0.75, col = "red", lty = 2)
plot(sft$fitIndices[, 1], sft$fitIndices[, 5],
     xlab = "Soft Threshold (power)", ylab = "Mean Connectivity",
     type = "n", main = paste("Mean connectivity"))
text(sft$fitIndices[, 1], sft$fitIndices[, 5],
     labels = powers, cex = 0.9, col = "red")

# Pick power: first power reaching R^2 >= 0.75 (lowest power with flattening connectivity) -> scale free 
idx_75 <- which(-sign(sft$fitIndices[, 3]) * sft$fitIndices[, 2] >= 0.75)
if (length(idx_75) > 0) {
  power_use <- sft$fitIndices$Power[min(idx_75)]
} else {
  power_use <- 6  # default fallback
}
cat("Selected soft-threshold power: ", power_use, "\n", sep = "")

# Save Threshold Plot and Data Point
pdf(file.path(out_dir, "02_soft_threshold_selection.pdf"), width = 10, height = 5)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(sft$fitIndices[, 1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[, 3]) * sft$fitIndices[, 2],
     xlab = "Soft Threshold (power)", ylab = "Scale Free Topology Model Fit, signed R^2",
     type = "n", main = paste("Scale independence"))
text(sft$fitIndices[, 1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[, 3]) * sft$fitIndices[, 2],
     labels = powers, cex = 0.9, col = "red")
abline(h = 0.75, col = "red", lty = 2)
plot(sft$fitIndices[, 1], sft$fitIndices[, 5],
     xlab = "Soft Threshold (power)", ylab = "Mean Connectivity",
     type = "n", main = paste("Mean connectivity"))
text(sft$fitIndices[, 1], sft$fitIndices[, 5],
     labels = powers, cex = 0.9, col = "red")
dev.off()
write_csv(sft$fitIndices, file.path(out_dir, "soft_threshold_fit.csv"))
```

```{r load-saved-WGCNA-optional}
# Set TRUE to skip blockwiseModules below and restore from a prior run.
reuse_wgcna_saved <- FALSE
wgcna_rds <- file.path(out_dir, "ShootWGCNA_objects.rds")
if (reuse_wgcna_saved) {
  if (!file.exists(wgcna_rds)) {
    stop("reuse_wgcna_saved is TRUE but file not found: ", wgcna_rds)
  }
  wgcna_obj <- readRDS(wgcna_rds)
  datExpr <- wgcna_obj$datExpr
  moduleColors <- wgcna_obj$moduleColors
  net <- wgcna_obj$net
  power_use <- wgcna_obj$power
  cat("Loaded saved WGCNA object from ", wgcna_rds, "\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r Network construction and module detection}
if (!reuse_wgcna_saved) {
  net <- blockwiseModules(
    datExpr,
    power = power_use,
    networkType = "signed",
    TOMType = "signed",
    minModuleSize = 30,
    reassignThreshold = 0,
    mergeCutHeight = 0.25,
    numericLabels = TRUE,
    pamRespectsDendro = FALSE,
    saveTOMs = TRUE,
    saveTOMFileBase = file.path(out_dir, "shootTOM"),
    verbose = 3
  )

  moduleColors <- labels2colors(net$colors) # Convert numeric labels to colors
}

table(moduleColors) %>% kable()

# Module summary: number of genes per module
module_sizes <- as.data.frame(table(moduleColors)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Module = moduleColors, nGenes = Freq) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(nGenes))
#write_csv(module_sizes, file.path(out_dir, "module_sizes.csv"))
# Gene-to-module assignment
gene_module_df <- tibble(
  gene = colnames(datExpr),
  module = moduleColors
)
#write_csv(gene_module_df, file.path(out_dir, "gene_module_assignment.csv"))
# Genes per module (one file per module)
module_list <- unique(moduleColors)
for (mod in module_list) {
  genes_in_mod <- gene_module_df %>% dplyr::filter(module == mod) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)
  #write_lines(genes_in_mod, file.path(out_dir, paste0("module_genes_", mod, ".txt")))
}
cat("Exported gene lists for ", length(module_list), " modules\n", sep = "")
```

## Non-Grey Module-Module Correlation Bubble Plot

```{r non-grey-module-module-correlation-bubble-plot}
is_grey_module <- function(module_name) {
  grepl("^MEgrey$", module_name, ignore.case = TRUE)
}

drop_grey_module <- function(me_mat) {
  me_mat[, !is_grey_module(colnames(me_mat)), drop = FALSE]
}

# Recalculate eigengenes from every assigned module color to ensure the plot
# cannot omit modules that may be absent from a saved MEs object.
non_grey_mes <- moduleEigengenes(datExpr, moduleColors)$eigengenes %>%
  orderMEs() %>%
  drop_grey_module()

expected_non_grey_modules <- setdiff(unique(as.character(moduleColors)), "grey")
missing_module_eigengenes <- setdiff(
  paste0("ME", expected_non_grey_modules),
  colnames(non_grey_mes)
)
if (length(missing_module_eigengenes) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing recalculated module eigengene(s): ",
    paste(missing_module_eigengenes, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (ncol(non_grey_mes) < 2) {
  stop("At least two non-grey module eigengenes are required.")
}

cat("Modules included in module-module plots: ",
    ncol(non_grey_mes), " of ", length(expected_non_grey_modules),
    " non-grey modules\n", sep = "")

module_cor_mat <- cor(non_grey_mes, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
module_hclust <- hclust(as.dist(1 - module_cor_mat), method = "complete")
module_order <- colnames(module_cor_mat)[module_hclust$order]

module_cor_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(module_cor_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Module1 = Var1,
    Module2 = Var2,
    Correlation = Freq
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Module1Index = match(as.character(Module1), module_order),
    Module2Index = match(as.character(Module2), module_order),
    n_samples = mapply(
      function(module1, module2) {
        sum(stats::complete.cases(
          non_grey_mes[, c(as.character(module1), as.character(module2)), drop = FALSE]
        ))
      },
      Module1,
      Module2
    ),
    t_statistic = Correlation * sqrt(
      (n_samples - 2) / pmax(1 - Correlation^2, .Machine$double.eps)
    ),
    pvalue = 2 * stats::pt(
      abs(t_statistic),
      df = n_samples - 2,
      lower.tail = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  # Keep each module pair once and omit self-correlations.
  dplyr::filter(Module1Index < Module2Index) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Module1 = factor(
      sub("^ME", "", as.character(Module1)),
      levels = sub("^ME", "", module_order)
    ),
    Module2 = factor(
      sub("^ME", "", as.character(Module2)),
      levels = rev(sub("^ME", "", module_order))
    ),
    AbsCorrelation = abs(Correlation)
  )

module_cor_bubble_plot <- ggplot(
  module_cor_df,
  aes(x = Module1, y = Module2, size = AbsCorrelation, color = Correlation)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "|Correlation|",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    range = c(1, 10)
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    name = "Correlation",
    low = "#5F8F9A",
    mid = "grey98",
    high = "burlywood3",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    title = "Significant non-grey module-module correlations",
    x = "Module",
    y = "Module"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

module_cor_bubble_plot

module_cor_plot_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "non_grey_module_module_correlation_bubble_plot.png"
)

ggsave(
  module_cor_plot_file,
  plot = module_cor_bubble_plot,
  width = max(8, ncol(non_grey_mes) * 0.35 + 4),
  height = max(7, ncol(non_grey_mes) * 0.35 + 3),
  units = "in",
  dpi = 150
)

# pheatmap retains all matrix rows and columns and draws both clustering
# dendrograms directly beside the heatmap.
module_cor_palette <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c("#5F8F9A", "grey98", "burlywood3")
)(101)

# Show all correlations in the upper-right half. Modules are hierarchically
# clustered using 1 - eigengene correlation as distance and complete linkage.
cluster_position <- match(
  seq_len(ncol(module_cor_mat)),
  module_hclust$order
)
lower_triangle_mask <- outer(cluster_position, cluster_position, ">")
module_cor_upper_triangle <- module_cor_mat
module_cor_upper_triangle[lower_triangle_mask] <- NA_real_

module_cor_heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  module_cor_upper_triangle,
  cluster_rows = module_hclust,
  cluster_cols = module_hclust,
  color = module_cor_palette,
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
  border_color = "white",
  labels_row = sub("^ME", "", rownames(module_cor_mat)),
  labels_col = sub("^ME", "", colnames(module_cor_mat)),
  treeheight_row = 70,
  treeheight_col = 70,
  fontsize = 8,
  na_col = "white",
  main = "All non-grey module-module correlations (upper triangle)",
  silent = TRUE
)

grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(module_cor_heatmap$gtable)

module_cor_heatmap_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "non_grey_module_module_correlation_clustered_heatmap.png"
)
ggsave(
  module_cor_heatmap_file,
  plot = module_cor_heatmap$gtable,
  width = max(9, ncol(non_grey_mes) * 0.35 + 4),
  height = max(8, ncol(non_grey_mes) * 0.35 + 3),
  units = "in",
  dpi = 180
)

write_csv(
  module_cor_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Module1 = as.character(Module1),
      Module2 = as.character(Module2)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Module1, Module2, Correlation, AbsCorrelation,
      pvalue, p.adj, n_samples
    ),
  file.path(out_dir, "non_grey_module_module_correlations.csv")
)

cat("Saved module-module correlation bubble plot to: ",
    module_cor_plot_file, "\n",
    "Saved clustered module-module correlation heatmap to: ",
    module_cor_heatmap_file, "\n", sep = "")
```

## Plot Module Eigengene by Module Color

Call `plot_module_eigengene()` with a module color, for example `plot_module_eigengene("blue")` or `plot_module_eigengene("MEblue")`. The plot shows each sample, mean ± 1 SD error bars, and a LOESS-smoothed mean nitrogen response for each CO2 treatment, with Line as facets. The function also prints an all-sample `Line × N × CO2` ANOVA and separate `N × CO2` ANOVAs within each line.

```{r plot-module-eigengene-function}
plot_module_eigengene <- function(module_color,
                                  me_mat = MEs,
                                  trait_df = phys_match,
                                  co2_levels = c("AC", "EC"),
                                  line_width = 1.2,
                                  smooth_span = 0.75,
                                  sample_point_size = 1.8,
                                  sample_point_alpha = 0.7,
                                  print_anova = TRUE,
                                  save_plot = FALSE,
                                  output_dir = out_dir) {
  module_name <- as.character(module_color)[1]
  if (!grepl("^ME", module_name)) {
    module_name <- paste0("ME", module_name)
  }

  if (!module_name %in% colnames(me_mat)) {
    stop(
      "Module eigengene not found: ", module_name,
      "\nAvailable modules: ", paste(colnames(me_mat), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  required_cols <- c("Line", "CO2", "Nitrogen")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(trait_df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Missing required trait column(s): ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }

  sample_ids <- intersect(rownames(trait_df), rownames(me_mat))
  if (length(sample_ids) == 0) {
    stop("No overlapping sample row names between trait_df and me_mat.")
  }

  plot_df <- trait_df[sample_ids, , drop = FALSE] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Sample = sample_ids,
      ME = as.numeric(me_mat[sample_ids, module_name]),
      Line = factor(Line),
      CO2 = factor(CO2, levels = co2_levels),
      Nitrogen_mM = as.numeric(as.character(Nitrogen))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(ME),
      !is.na(Line),
      !is.na(CO2),
      is.finite(Nitrogen_mM)
    )

  if (nrow(plot_df) == 0) {
    stop("No complete rows available to plot ", module_name, ".")
  }

  nitrogen_breaks <- sort(unique(plot_df$Nitrogen_mM))

  trend <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Line, CO2, Nitrogen_mM) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_ME = mean(ME, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_ME = sd(ME, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sd_ME = dplyr::if_else(is.na(sd_ME) | is.nan(sd_ME), 0, sd_ME)
    )

  co2_colors <- c(AC = "cadetblue2", EC = "cadetblue4")
  missing_color_levels <- setdiff(levels(droplevels(plot_df$CO2)), names(co2_colors))
  if (length(missing_color_levels) > 0) {
    extra_colors <- grDevices::hcl.colors(length(missing_color_levels), "Dark 3")
    co2_colors <- c(co2_colors, stats::setNames(extra_colors, missing_color_levels))
  }

  p <- ggplot(trend, aes(x = Nitrogen_mM, y = mean_ME, color = CO2, group = CO2))

  p <- p +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean_ME - sd_ME, ymax = mean_ME + sd_ME),
      width = 0.15,
      linewidth = 0.55
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = plot_df,
      aes(x = Nitrogen_mM, y = ME, color = CO2),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      size = sample_point_size,
      alpha = sample_point_alpha
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "loess",
      formula = y ~ x,
      span = smooth_span,
      se = FALSE,
      linewidth = line_width
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(name = expression(CO[2]), values = co2_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = nitrogen_breaks,
      labels = function(x) format(x, trim = TRUE, drop0trailing = TRUE)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Line) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(module_name, " eigengene"),
      x = "Nitrogen (mM)",
      y = "Module eigengene"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  if (print_anova) {
    anova_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Line = droplevels(Line),
        CO2 = droplevels(CO2)
      )

    anova_note <- "all data"
    if (module_name == "MEgreen") {
      green_iqr_df <- anova_df %>%
        dplyr::group_by(Line, CO2, Nitrogen_mM) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          .q1 = stats::quantile(ME, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
          .q3 = stats::quantile(ME, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
          .iqr = .q3 - .q1,
          .is_outlier = ME < (.q1 - 1.5 * .iqr) | ME > (.q3 + 1.5 * .iqr)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup()

      removed_green_outliers <- green_iqr_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(.is_outlier)

      anova_df <- green_iqr_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(!.is_outlier) %>%
        dplyr::select(-.q1, -.q3, -.iqr, -.is_outlier)

      cat(
        "\nRemoved ", nrow(removed_green_outliers),
        " MEgreen outlier(s) using the 1.5 x IQR rule within Line x CO2 x Nitrogen groups",
        if (nrow(removed_green_outliers) > 0) {
          paste0(": ", paste(removed_green_outliers$Sample, collapse = ", "))
        } else {
          "."
        },
        "\n",
        sep = ""
      )
      anova_note <- "after within-treatment 1.5 x IQR outlier removal"
    }

    if (
      nrow(anova_df) >= 3L &&
      nlevels(anova_df$Line) > 1L &&
      nlevels(anova_df$CO2) > 1L &&
      dplyr::n_distinct(anova_df$Nitrogen_mM) > 1L
    ) {
      cat("\n## ", module_name, " ANOVA - Line x N (numeric) x CO2 (", anova_note, ")\n\n", sep = "")
      fit_full <- aov(ME ~ Line * Nitrogen_mM * CO2, data = anova_df)
      print(summary(fit_full))

      for (ln in levels(droplevels(anova_df$Line))) {
        sub <- anova_df %>% dplyr::filter(Line == ln)
        if (nrow(sub) < 3L || nlevels(droplevels(sub$CO2)) < 2L || dplyr::n_distinct(sub$Nitrogen_mM) < 2L) next

        cat("\n## ", module_name, " ANOVA - Line: ", ln, " (N numeric x CO2)\n\n", sep = "")
        fit_line <- aov(ME ~ Nitrogen_mM * CO2, data = sub)
        print(summary(fit_line))
      }
    } else {
      cat("\n## ", module_name, " ANOVA skipped - insufficient Line, CO2, or N replication\n\n", sep = "")
    }
  }

  if (save_plot) {
    plot_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(module_name, "_eigengene_line_plot.png"))
    ggsave(plot_file, plot = p, width = 7, height = 4.5, units = "in", dpi = 150)
    cat("Saved module eigengene plot to: ", plot_file, "\n", sep = "")
  }

  return(p)
}
```

## Prepare Traits for Correlation Figures

```{r prepare-correlation-figure-traits}
# Match the test-script trait table while using the publication shoot traits.
correlation_phys <- read_csv(
  here("Data", "A17_sunn_nodule.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE
)
supplemental_traits <- read_csv(
  file.path(in_dir, "Trait_A17_sunn.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::select(RNA.seq.id, ShootCN_ratio, N_soil_uptake_mg, SPAD) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(RNA.seq.id, .keep_all = TRUE)
correlation_phys_match <- correlation_phys %>%
  dplyr::left_join(supplemental_traits, by = "RNA.seq.id") %>%
  dplyr::filter(RNA.seq.id %in% rownames(datExpr)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(RNA.seq.id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(correlation_phys_match) <- correlation_phys_match$RNA.seq.id
correlation_phys_match <- correlation_phys_match[rownames(datExpr), , drop = FALSE]
correlation_phys_match$Line <- as.character(trimws(correlation_phys_match$Line))
```

## Correlate Traits with Shoot Modules

This script uses `A17_sunn_nodule.csv` as the primary trait table and adds `ShootCN_ratio`, `N_soil_uptake_mg`, and `SPAD` from the publication `Trait_A17_sunn.csv`. It uses `FixedN` if that column exists; otherwise it treats `FixedN` as the display/output name for `N_fixed_mg`. Sample `MTNC181` is excluded only from the `Ndfa_pct` correlations.

```{r fixedn-ndfa-biomass-module-trait-correlation}
fixedn_column <- if ("FixedN" %in% names(correlation_phys_match)) "FixedN" else "N_fixed_mg"
trait_lookup <- c(
  "Ndfa%" = "Ndfa_pct",
  "Fixed N" = fixedn_column,
  "Nodule Biomass" = "NoduleBiomass_mg",
  "Total Biomass" = "TotalBiomass_mg",
  "Soil N uptake" = "N_soil_uptake_mg",
  "C/N ratio" = "ShootCN_ratio",
  "Chlorophyll/SPAD" = "SPAD"
)

missing_traits <- setdiff(unname(trait_lookup), names(correlation_phys_match))
if (length(missing_traits) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required trait column(s): ", paste(missing_traits, collapse = ", "))
}

drop_const <- function(mat) {
  sds <- apply(mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  mat[, sds > 0 & !is.na(sds), drop = FALSE]
}

format_trait_matrix <- function(trait_df) {
  trait_mat <- as.matrix(trait_df[, unname(trait_lookup), drop = FALSE])
  colnames(trait_mat) <- names(trait_lookup)
  rownames(trait_mat) <- rownames(trait_df)

  # Exclude MTNC181 from Ndfa% only; retain it for all other traits.
  trait_mat[rownames(trait_mat) == "MTNC181", "Ndfa%"] <- NA_real_

  drop_const(trait_mat)
}

format_module_trait_cor <- function(me_mat, trait_mat, scope, line_name = NA_character_) {
  if (nrow(me_mat) < 3 || ncol(trait_mat) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  # Calculate each trait separately so its p-values and sample count reflect
  # trait-specific missing values and exclusions.
  purrr::map_dfr(colnames(trait_mat), function(trait_name) {
    complete_idx <- complete.cases(me_mat, trait_mat[, trait_name])
    n_complete <- sum(complete_idx)
    if (n_complete < 3) {
      return(tibble())
    }

    trait_cor <- cor(
      me_mat[complete_idx, , drop = FALSE],
      trait_mat[complete_idx, trait_name]
    )

    tibble(
      Module = rownames(trait_cor),
      Trait = trait_name,
      cor = as.numeric(trait_cor),
      pvalue = as.numeric(corPvalueStudent(trait_cor, n_complete)),
      n_samples = n_complete
    )
  }) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Trait) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "fdr")) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Scope = scope,
      Line = line_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Scope, Line, Module, Trait, cor, pvalue, p.adj, n_samples)
}

combined_traits_mat <- format_trait_matrix(correlation_phys_match)
combined_res <- format_module_trait_cor(
  MEs[rownames(correlation_phys_match), , drop = FALSE],
  combined_traits_mat,
  scope = "combined"
)

line_res_list <- list()
for (line_name in sort(unique(na.omit(correlation_phys_match$Line)))) {
  idx_line <- !is.na(correlation_phys_match$Line) & correlation_phys_match$Line == line_name
  if (sum(idx_line, na.rm = TRUE) < 3) {
    next
  }

  phys_line <- correlation_phys_match[idx_line, , drop = FALSE]
  line_traits_mat <- format_trait_matrix(phys_line)

  # Subset the globally oriented eigengenes so correlation signs remain
  # directly comparable among All Samples, A17, and sunn.
  MEs_line <- MEs[rownames(phys_line), , drop = FALSE]

  line_res_list[[line_name]] <- format_module_trait_cor(
    MEs_line,
    line_traits_mat,
    scope = "by_line",
    line_name = line_name
  )
}

by_line_res <- bind_rows(line_res_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is_grey_module(Module))
combined_res <- combined_res %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is_grey_module(Module))
module_trait_cor_all <- bind_rows(combined_res, by_line_res) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is_grey_module(Module))

write_csv(combined_res, file.path(out_dir, "module_trait_cor_combined_TotalBiomass_NoduleBiomass_Ndfa_pct_FixedN_ShootCN_ratio_SoilNUptake_SPAD.csv"))
write_csv(by_line_res, file.path(out_dir, "module_trait_cor_by_line_TotalBiomass_NoduleBiomass_Ndfa_pct_FixedN_ShootCN_ratio_SoilNUptake_SPAD.csv"))
write_csv(module_trait_cor_all, file.path(out_dir, "module_trait_cor_all_TotalBiomass_NoduleBiomass_Ndfa_pct_FixedN_ShootCN_ratio_SoilNUptake_SPAD.csv"))

cat("Saved non-grey module-trait correlations, including SPAD.\n")
```

## Prepare Matrices for Phenotype-Correlation Clustering

```{r prepare-phenotype-correlation-matrices}
heatmap_df <- module_trait_cor_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ScopeLabel = dplyr::if_else(Scope == "combined", "All Samples", Line)
  )

scope_levels <- c(
  "All Samples",
  "A17",
  "sunn",
  sort(setdiff(unique(heatmap_df$ScopeLabel), c("All Samples", "A17", "sunn")))
)

heatmap_df <- heatmap_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Trait = factor(Trait, levels = names(trait_lookup)),
    ScopeLabel = factor(ScopeLabel, levels = scope_levels),
    HeatmapTrait = paste(Trait, ScopeLabel, sep = "_")
  )

heatmap_col_order <- heatmap_df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Trait, ScopeLabel, HeatmapTrait) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Trait, ScopeLabel) %>%
  dplyr::pull(HeatmapTrait)

cor_wide <- heatmap_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Module, HeatmapTrait, cor) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = HeatmapTrait, values_from = cor) %>%
  dplyr::select(Module, dplyr::all_of(heatmap_col_order))

padj_wide <- heatmap_df %>%
  dplyr::select(Module, HeatmapTrait, p.adj) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = HeatmapTrait, values_from = p.adj) %>%
  dplyr::select(Module, dplyr::all_of(heatmap_col_order))

cor_mat <- as.matrix(cor_wide %>% dplyr::select(-Module))
rownames(cor_mat) <- cor_wide$Module

padj_mat <- as.matrix(padj_wide %>% dplyr::select(-Module))
rownames(padj_mat) <- padj_wide$Module
padj_mat <- padj_mat[rownames(cor_mat), colnames(cor_mat), drop = FALSE]

column_metadata <- heatmap_df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(HeatmapTrait, Trait, ScopeLabel) %>%
  dplyr::filter(HeatmapTrait %in% colnames(cor_mat)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(match(HeatmapTrait, colnames(cor_mat)))

column_trait_labels <- as.character(column_metadata$Trait)
column_scope_labels <- as.character(column_metadata$ScopeLabel)

display_mat <- matrix(
  paste0(
    sprintf("%.2f", cor_mat),
    ifelse(padj_mat < 0.001, "***",
           ifelse(padj_mat < 0.01, "**",
                  ifelse(padj_mat < 0.05, "*", "")))
  ),
  nrow = nrow(cor_mat),
  ncol = ncol(cor_mat),
  dimnames = dimnames(cor_mat)
)
display_mat[is.na(cor_mat)] <- ""

```

## Cluster Modules by Phenotype-Correlation Profile

This supervised view groups modules that have similar correlation patterns across traits and the All Samples, A17, and sunn scopes. It is separate from the module-module eigengene correlation clustering above.

```{r module-phenotype-profile-clustering}
if (nrow(cor_mat) < 2 || ncol(cor_mat) < 2) {
  stop("At least two modules and two trait-scope combinations are required.")
}

# Compare each pair of modules across its complete phenotype-correlation
# profile. Correlation distance emphasizes similarity in response patterns.
trait_profile_similarity <- stats::cor(
  t(cor_mat),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

if (anyNA(trait_profile_similarity)) {
  warning(
    "Undefined trait-profile similarities were set to zero before clustering."
  )
  trait_profile_similarity[is.na(trait_profile_similarity)] <- 0
}
diag(trait_profile_similarity) <- 1

trait_profile_hclust <- hclust(
  as.dist(1 - trait_profile_similarity),
  method = "average"
)

trait_profile_annotation <- column_metadata %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    HeatmapTrait,
    Trait = as.character(Trait),
    Scope = as.character(ScopeLabel)
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(trait_profile_annotation) <- trait_profile_annotation$HeatmapTrait
trait_profile_annotation$HeatmapTrait <- NULL
trait_profile_annotation <- trait_profile_annotation[
  colnames(cor_mat),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

trait_sequence <- trait_profile_annotation$Trait
trait_gaps <- which(trait_sequence[-1] != trait_sequence[-length(trait_sequence)])

trait_profile_palette <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c("#5F8F9A", "grey98", "burlywood3")
)(101)

# Annotate only FDR-significant module-trait correlations with the correlation
# value and the same significance stars used in the trait heatmap.
trait_profile_display <- display_mat[
  rownames(cor_mat),
  colnames(cor_mat),
  drop = FALSE
]
trait_profile_display[
  is.na(padj_mat) | padj_mat >= 0.05
] <- ""

trait_profile_heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  cor_mat,
  cluster_rows = trait_profile_hclust,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  color = trait_profile_palette,
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
  border_color = "white",
  annotation_col = trait_profile_annotation,
  gaps_col = trait_gaps,
  labels_row = sub("^ME", "", rownames(cor_mat)),
  labels_col = trait_profile_annotation$Scope,
  display_numbers = trait_profile_display,
  number_color = "black",
  fontsize_number = 6,
  treeheight_row = 80,
  fontsize = 8,
  angle_col = "45",
  main = "Modules clustered by phenotype-correlation profile",
  silent = TRUE
)

grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(trait_profile_heatmap$gtable)

trait_profile_heatmap_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "modules_clustered_by_phenotype_correlation_profile.png"
)
ggsave(
  trait_profile_heatmap_file,
  plot = trait_profile_heatmap$gtable,
  width = max(11, ncol(cor_mat) * 0.5 + 5),
  height = max(8, nrow(cor_mat) * 0.3 + 4),
  units = "in",
  dpi = 180
)

trait_profile_module_order <- tibble(
  ClusterOrder = seq_along(trait_profile_hclust$order),
  Module = sub(
    "^ME",
    "",
    rownames(cor_mat)[trait_profile_hclust$order]
  )
)
write_csv(
  trait_profile_module_order,
  file.path(out_dir, "module_phenotype_profile_cluster_order.csv")
)

cat("Saved phenotype-profile clustered heatmap to: ",
    trait_profile_heatmap_file, "\n", sep = "")
```

##ExamGOEnrichment for module of interest

```{r topgo-load-annotation}
# Create GO enrichment output directory
go_out_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "GO_enrichment")
dir.create(go_out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("GO enrichment output: ", go_out_dir, "\n", sep = "")

# Load GO gene pairs annotation
go_file <- here("MT_genome", "annotation", "GO_gene_pairs_MtrunA17r5.tsv")
if (!file.exists(go_file)) {
  stop("GO annotation file not found: ", go_file)
}
go_pairs <- read_tsv(go_file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                    show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(gene = LOCUS_TAG, go = GO) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", !is.na(go), go != "") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, go)

# Build GO2genes: list where names are GO IDs, values are gene vectors (required by topGO)
GO2genes <- split(go_pairs$gene, go_pairs$go)
cat("GO annotation: ", nrow(go_pairs), " gene-GO pairs, ", length(GO2genes), " GO terms\n", sep = "")
```

```{r topgo-enrichment}
library(topGO)
library(GO.db)

# Every assigned module. Grey is the unclustered WGCNA bin.
modules_of_interest <- gene_module_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(module != "grey") %>%
  dplyr::count(module, name = "n_genes") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_genes)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(module)

all_genes <- colnames(datExpr)
go_root_ids <- c("GO:0008150", "GO:0003674", "GO:0005575")
max_annotated <- 300

cat("Running topGO for ", length(modules_of_interest),
    " modules; universe ", length(all_genes), " genes\n", sep = "")

topgo_bp_all <- list()
topgo_sig_all <- list()

for (module_label in modules_of_interest) {
  module_genes <- gene_module_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(module == module_label) %>%
    dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
    unique()

  cat("Module ", module_label, ": ", length(module_genes), " genes\n", sep = "")

  if (length(module_genes) < 5) {
    cat("  skipped: fewer than 5 genes\n")
    next
  }

  gene_list <- setNames(as.integer(all_genes %in% module_genes), all_genes)

  GOdata <- new(
    "topGOdata",
    ontology = "BP",
    allGenes = gene_list,
    geneSel = function(x) x == 1,
    annot = annFUN.GO2genes,
    GO2genes = GO2genes,
    nodeSize = 5
  )

  res_fisher <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "classic", statistic = "fisher")
  n_tested <- length(score(res_fisher))

  topgo_bp <- GenTable(
    GOdata,
    Fisher = res_fisher,
    orderBy = "Fisher",
    ranksOf = "Fisher",
    topNodes = n_tested,
    numChar = 200
  )

  if (nrow(topgo_bp) == 0) {
    cat("  no tested BP terms\n")
    next
  }

  go_info <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    GO.db,
    keys = unique(topgo_bp$GO.ID),
    keytype = "GOID",
    columns = c("TERM", "ONTOLOGY")
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(GOID, .keep_all = TRUE)

  topgo_bp <- topgo_bp %>%
    dplyr::left_join(go_info %>% dplyr::rename(GO.ID = GOID), by = "GO.ID") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Module = module_label,
      QueryGeneN = length(module_genes),
      Fisher.pval = dplyr::if_else(grepl("^<", Fisher), 1e-30, as.numeric(Fisher)),
      n_tested = n_tested,
      # BH across every tested term. Adjusting only the top 200 preselected
      # terms treats m as 200 and is too lenient.
      p.adj = p.adjust(Fisher.pval, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!GO.ID %in% go_root_ids, Annotated <= max_annotated)

  topgo_sig <- topgo_bp %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(p.adj), p.adj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p.adj)

  write_csv(topgo_bp, file.path(go_out_dir, paste0("TopGO_ShootWGCNA_module_", module_label, "_BP.csv")))
  write_csv(topgo_sig, file.path(go_out_dir, paste0("TopGO_ShootWGCNA_module_", module_label, "_significant.csv")))

  topgo_bp_all[[module_label]] <- topgo_bp
  topgo_sig_all[[module_label]] <- topgo_sig

  cat("  BH across ", n_tested, " terms; ",
      nrow(topgo_bp), " retained; ",
      nrow(topgo_sig), " with p.adj < 0.05\n", sep = "")
}

topgo_bp <- dplyr::bind_rows(topgo_bp_all)
topgo_sig <- dplyr::bind_rows(topgo_sig_all)

write_csv(topgo_bp, file.path(go_out_dir, "TopGO_ShootWGCNA_all_modules_BP.csv"))
write_csv(topgo_sig, file.path(go_out_dir, "TopGO_ShootWGCNA_all_modules_significant.csv"))

cat("TopGO results saved to ", go_out_dir, "\n", sep = "")
cat("  - ", length(topgo_bp_all), " modules tested\n", sep = "")
cat("  - ", nrow(topgo_sig), " module-term rows with p.adj < 0.05\n", sep = "")
```

```{r plot-red-green-go-enrichment, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
classify_go_category <- function(term) {
  term_lower <- tolower(term)

  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl(
      "carbon fixation|calvin|ribulose|rubisco|carboxylation",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Carbon fixation",
    grepl(
      "chlorophyll|pigment|tetrapyrrole|porphyrin|heme|protoporphyrin",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Chlorophyll",
    grepl(
      "photosynth|photosystem|light reaction",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Photosynthesis",
    grepl(
      "chloroplast|plastid|thylakoid",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Chloroplast & Plastids",
    grepl(
      "amino acid|aminoacyl|arginine|glutamine|methionine|threonine|isoleucine|tryptophan|homoserine|serine|amine|indol|nitrogen",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Amino acid metabolism",
    grepl(
      "respiration|glycol|glucose|pyruvate|tricarbox|oxidative phosphorylation|electron transport|acetyl-coa|energy derivation|glycerol|alditol|dicarbox|monocarbox",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Carbon & energy metabolism",
    grepl(
      "nucleotide|nucleoside|nucleobase|ribonucleotide|purine|pyridine|atp|adp|ribose phosphate|organophosphate|rrna|trna|translation|rna capping|rna stability|rna catabolic|rna metabolic|rna destabil",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Nucleotide & RNA metabolism",
    grepl(
      "lipid|fatty acid|acyl-coa|phosphatidyl|sterol|palmitoyl|lipoprotein|flavin|riboflavin|molybdopterin|cofactor|prosthetic|pteridine|sulfur",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Lipid & cofactor metabolism",
    grepl(
      "autophag|phagophore|proteasom|ubiquitin|protein catabolic|proteolysis|protein folding|protein repair|chaperone|desumoyl|protein modification|dephosphorylation",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Proteostasis & autophagy",
    grepl(
      "vacuol|endosom|vesicle|exocyt|secretion|membrane docking|membrane fusion|localization|targeting|transport|protein import|organelle organization",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Transport & trafficking",
    grepl(
      "response|stress|starvation|signaling|signal transduction|cell communication|homeostasis|redox|recognition|defense|hypersensitive|chitin|metal ion|circadian|development|pollen|endosperm|seedling",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "Signaling, stress & development",
    grepl(
      "dna|chromosome|cell cycle|transcription|gene expression",
      term_lower
    ) ~ "DNA, transcription & cell cycle",
    TRUE ~ "Other cellular processes"
  )
}

go_enrichment_df <- lapply(
  go_modules,
  function(module_name) {
    go_file <- file.path(
      go_enrichment_dir,
      paste0("TopGO_ShootWGCNA_module_", module_name, "_significant.csv")
    )
    if (!file.exists(go_file)) {
      stop("GO enrichment file not found: ", go_file)
    }

    readr::read_csv(go_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Module = module_name)
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Module = factor(Module, levels = go_modules),
    p.adj = as.numeric(p.adj),
    Fisher.pval = as.numeric(Fisher.pval),
    Significant = as.numeric(Significant),
    Expected = as.numeric(Expected),
    Term = dplyr::coalesce(TERM, Term),
    plot_p = dplyr::if_else(!is.na(p.adj), p.adj, Fisher.pval),
    FoldEnrichment = Significant / Expected
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(plot_p),
    plot_p < 0.05,
    is.finite(FoldEnrichment),
    !is.na(GO.ID)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Category = factor(classify_go_category(Term), levels = go_category_levels),
    Log10FDR = -log10(pmax(plot_p, .Machine$double.xmin))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Module, Category, plot_p, dplyr::desc(FoldEnrichment))

readr::write_csv(
  go_enrichment_df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Module,
      GO.ID,
      Term,
      Category,
      FDR = plot_p,
      FoldEnrichment,
      Significant
    ),
  file.path(out_dir, "red_green_significant_GO_categories.csv")
)

go_fdr_limits <- range(go_enrichment_df$Log10FDR, finite = TRUE)
go_gene_limits <- range(go_enrichment_df$Significant, finite = TRUE)
go_terms_per_category <- 5L

plot_module_go <- function(module_name) {
  module_go_df <- go_enrichment_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(Module) == module_name,
      as.character(Category) != "Other cellular processes"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Category) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(plot_p, dplyr::desc(FoldEnrichment), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = go_terms_per_category) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Category, plot_p, dplyr::desc(FoldEnrichment)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      TermWrapped = vapply(
        Term,
        function(x) paste(strwrap(x, width = 42), collapse = "<br>"),
        character(1)
      ),
      TermFacet = paste(GO.ID, TermWrapped, sep = "__"),
      TermFacet = factor(TermFacet, levels = rev(unique(TermFacet)))
    )

  go_axis_labels <- stats::setNames(
    paste0(
      "<b><span style='color:",
      unname(go_category_colors[as.character(module_go_df$Category)]),
      "'>",
      module_go_df$TermWrapped,
      "</span></b>"
    ),
    as.character(module_go_df$TermFacet)
  )

  ggplot(
    module_go_df,
    aes(
      x = FoldEnrichment,
      y = TermFacet,
      size = Significant,
      color = Log10FDR
    )
  ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 0, xend = FoldEnrichment, yend = TermFacet),
      color = "grey70",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(x = Inf, fill = Category),
      shape = 22,
      alpha = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = go_axis_labels) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = c("#FDE725", "#90D743", "#35B779", "#31688E", "#440154"),
      name = expression(-log[10]("FDR")),
      limits = go_fdr_limits
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "GO category",
      values = go_category_colors,
      drop = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Significant genes",
      range = c(1.5, 4.5),
      limits = go_gene_limits
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        tools::toTitleCase(module_name),
        " module — top ",
        go_terms_per_category,
        " GO terms per category"
      ),
      x = "Fold enrichment",
      y = "GO term"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 5.6),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      plot.margin = margin(4, 8, 4, 4)
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_colorbar(order = 1, direction = "vertical"),
      fill = guide_legend(
        order = 2,
        ncol = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, shape = 22, size = 3)
      ),
      size = guide_legend(order = 3, ncol = 1)
    )
}

red_go_plot <- plot_module_go("red")
green_go_plot <- plot_module_go("green")

red_go_plot
green_go_plot

cat(
  "GO terms plotted: ",
  paste(
    names(table(go_enrichment_df$Module)),
    as.integer(table(go_enrichment_df$Module)),
    sep = " = ",
    collapse = "; "
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

```{r plot-top-six-go-categories-by-module, fig.width=9, fig.height=10}
plot_top_six_go_categories <- function(module_name) {
  top_categories <- go_enrichment_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(Module) == module_name,
      as.character(Category) != "Other cellular processes"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Category) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      SignificantGO = dplyr::n_distinct(GO.ID),
      BestFDR = min(plot_p, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(SignificantGO), BestFDR) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 6) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Category) %>%
    as.character()

  if (
    module_name == "red" &&
    !"Photosynthesis" %in% top_categories &&
    "Lipid & cofactor metabolism" %in% top_categories
  ) {
    top_categories[
      top_categories == "Lipid & cofactor metabolism"
    ] <- "Photosynthesis"
  }

  top_go_df <- go_enrichment_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      as.character(Module) == module_name,
      as.character(Category) %in% top_categories
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      SelectedCategory = factor(as.character(Category), levels = top_categories)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(SelectedCategory) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(plot_p, dplyr::desc(FoldEnrichment), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 5) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(SelectedCategory, plot_p, dplyr::desc(FoldEnrichment)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      TermWrapped = vapply(
        Term,
        function(x) paste(strwrap(x, width = 42), collapse = "<br>"),
        character(1)
      ),
      TermFacet = paste(GO.ID, TermWrapped, sep = "__"),
      TermFacet = factor(TermFacet, levels = rev(unique(TermFacet)))
    )

  go_axis_labels <- stats::setNames(
    paste0(
      "<b><span style='color:",
      unname(go_category_colors[as.character(top_go_df$Category)]),
      "'>",
      top_go_df$TermWrapped,
      "</span></b>"
    ),
    as.character(top_go_df$TermFacet)
  )

  ggplot(
    top_go_df,
    aes(
      x = FoldEnrichment,
      y = TermFacet,
      size = Significant,
      color = Log10FDR
    )
  ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 0, xend = FoldEnrichment, yend = TermFacet),
      color = "grey70",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(x = Inf, fill = Category),
      shape = 22,
      alpha = 0
    ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = go_axis_labels) +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = c("#FDE725", "#90D743", "#35B779", "#31688E", "#440154"),
      name = expression(-log[10]("FDR")),
      limits = go_fdr_limits
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "GO category",
      values = go_category_colors,
      drop = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Significant genes",
      range = c(2, 7),
      limits = go_gene_limits
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        tools::toTitleCase(module_name),
        " module — top 6 GO categories (top 5 terms each)"
      ),
      x = "Fold enrichment",
      y = "GO term"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 7),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_colorbar(order = 1, direction = "vertical"),
      fill = guide_legend(
        order = 2,
        ncol = 1,
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, shape = 22, size = 3)
      ),
      size = guide_legend(order = 3, ncol = 1)
    )
}
```
